lines.t: Verse 1
In the silence, I hear You call my name
Through the chaos, You’re the calm in my veins
I’ve been broken, but You make me whole again
Your fire burns away the pain
Pre-Chorus
Every scar is a story You’ve rewritten
Every tear a promise not forgotten
Chorus
I rise from the ashes, light in my soul
YahuShua, You’ve made me whole
No more shadows, no more chains
Your mercy runs through my veins
Verse 2
When the night tries to drown my faith
You remind me love’s a holy flame
I’m not lost, I’m not the same
You breathe life into my name
Pre-Chorus
Every scar is a story You’ve rewritten
Every tear a promise not forgotten
Chorus
I rise from the ashes, light in my soul
YahuShua, You’ve made me whole
No more shadows, no more chains
Your mercy runs through my veins
Bridge
The darkness trembles when I sing Your name
YahuShua, You break the grave
Your love, my armor, my eternal flame
Final Chorus
I rise from the ashes, my heart restored
Forever Yours, forever more
In Your light, I am free
Your truth is the air I breathe
